notes.title: 🍬💊 Healing Patch 1.0.1 💊🍬

As there were no game breaking bugs (thankfully!) reported so far I was able to do this.[/p][p][/p][h3]Here are the fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the location names in the Achievement brooch panels.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased difficulty for the "Hearts collected per day" achievement. All tiers now require a bit less Hearts.[/p][/*][*][p]Tweaked stock savings to be a little more consistent per mission. Boosted savings gain. Decreased last tier of the Stock achievement a bit.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed what was causing the dose of some candies to never be "ideal" in level 1.[/p][/*][*][p]New screen resolutions were added in the Options.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Also, thank you again for your support by playing and giving feedback <3[/p]

notes.title: 🍭 Beta testing coming + Updates
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Guardian![/b]

I’m so excited we are getting closer and closer to the final vision of the game!
If you’re part of the mailing list Magical Guardian’s Club you get the chance to participate in the Beta Test coming [b]this Wednesday (April 16th)[/b]. So make sure to join so you can get an exclusive Steam Key and help directly in the development!
Link: [url=https://berrylemonadestudio.beehiiv.com/subscribe]https://berrylemonadestudio.beehiiv.com/subscribe[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/77b832c060c626a566efc6e2925d3212cef6a4cd.png[/img]

That out of the way, let me show you some new things you will see in the game!

There’s a whole [b]new Rewards + Goals system[/b]!
You will now have a magical girl brooch that will show you your goals and achievements and reward you Hearts for that. Let’s see if you can get all the achievements!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/4f17f03395880bb11ebdc77360d55d252d2a310a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/02a1fa9819e3228c3ebb131d872ad5c7ea153784.png[/img]

And yes, it is shaped like a macaroon. 

Each level will now have a [b]special goal[/b] to achieve. They’re optional but let’s see if you can rise to the challenge. I believe in you!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/a8ea4f3219e96ada7dd0b6bb086fdaa46dc62927.png[/img]

Things were a bit too passive in the missions so now it is up to YOU to actually heal the citizens. Your wand detects the citizens who are ready for your magic, point your wand on them and [b]click to heal[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/f465c77d172e9e460b8d5a2dd649a3a4953a4825.gif[/img]

There’s also a new Power Upgrade where you can let your wand do the job if you want because as you get a lot of citizens on screen things can get quite hectic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/c185f02c54320c89ebd17df3552fd4c265e87185.png[/img]

And there are some other smaller updates too:
[list]
[*] Guide: some panels with more detailed information of what you learned in the tutorial with Taffy. You can consult anytime now.
[*] Darker screen: this specific aesthetic of the game can be a bit too bright so now there’s a brightness slider to adjust it.
[*] One new clothing set for this Beta (full game will have them all!)
[*] Some text alignment corrections were also made.
[/list]

That’s it! Thank you so much for reading and I hope you are excited for the Beta!

Stay magical ✨
Love,
Erika🍋

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/ea11469758097e5c9131ebfe82c9f6a8ba384977.png[/img]

notes.title: The Demo will stay up! + Some patch updates

Steam Next Fest week ended but the good news is in the title: [b]I’m keeping the demo up[/b]!

I also updated the Demo fixing some issues you kindly reported:
[list]
[*] Fixed black screen ocurring at the start of the game for some systems.
[*] Fixed Reset Save button not really resetting every data.
[*] Fixed the Well-being score going down on the map screen. It won’t decrease anymore.
[/list]

Keep up updating me with issues and giving feedback! You can do so either leaving a review on the demo page or in the Discussions forum: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3120000/discussions/][/url]

There are more improvements I’m working on regarding balancing numbers, improving game progression, quality of life and adding more content for the wardrobe.

Stay magical ✨
Love,
Erika🍋

notes.title: 🍭You can now play dress-up in Pretty Sweet! + Playtest news
notes.notes:
[b]Hello pretty guardian![/b]
Another year is coming to an end, this fills me with lots of feelings. 
I’ve been busy developing Pretty Sweet! and I’m here to share about a highly anticipated feature! You saw it in the title already but lets roll the drums! 
*Drum rolls* 🥁 brr 🥁 brr 🥁 

🥳🎉 You can change your magical girl clothes in the game! 🎉🥳
AND it affects gameplay, so it’s not just aesthetics.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/80dcaa24568352a23ecc8a0ae2477d20b725ff02.gif[/img]

This is the new closet screen where you can change your looks not only clothes but hair and skin color and eyes color. Also notice this brand new hairstyle added!

Originally I was not going to include this because I wanted to keep this game very small but maaaybe I’ve been playing dress up games too much *cough* Infin*cough* Nikk*cough* that’s why I caved in to scope creep! Yay!

The demo will have 3 full sets of clothes but the full game will have more. And you can mix and match the pieces. You have to buy the pieces with you hard earned Hearts, the currency of the game, so it feels rewarding!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/a7371158a80e128fd91c50c0642e92a388fd8d7d.png[/img]

Each piece has a certain emotion attached to it. They can be used to attract more citizens with that particular emotion. This is useful when you have a lot of magic stock that balances that feeling so you can heal more people!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/c0393cf25756308d0ae8d2a9efe51a807ad61a8c.png[/img]

[b]Speaking of DEMO [/b]👀 I’ll be rolling a playtest in January so make sure to subscribe to my newsletter because I’ll send more info about that soon!
[url=https://berrylemonadestudio.beehiiv.com/subscribe]Subscribe to save your spot in the playtest![/url]

I hope you have time to rest a lot and play lots of games in the holidays!
Keep being magical and Happy new year ✨
Love,
Erika 🍋

notes.title: 🍬 The future of Pretty Sweet! Healing Guardian
notes.notes:
[b]Hello Guardians! Hope you are well.[/b]
Whew. It’s been a while.

The original idea was to send an update on the game once a month so you know I’m still working on it and to get you closer to the development process. I even had playtests and planned a demo release for this october Steam Next Fest but life took an unexpected turn recently and… before explaining it better let me first give you a treat. 

This is the new map for the game! Welcome to the cozy [b]San Marzipan[/b]! You will be able to choose where to have your guardian missions as you unlock each one. I hope you find it cute!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136355/35fab767a857859c5458a1bd46ec6a0292982a2e.jpg[/img]

Ok, a bit of sadness now (Content warning: d**th)
I’m not sure if you know this already but this game is being developed by myself alone and I had to pause development because my dad passed away and even some months before that development was slow because of medical care he needed. So I hope you understand. And I’m doing better now, in case you’re concerned (thank you), that’s why I can finally write this post.

So on a brighter side now, Pretty Sweet! Healing Guardian development will be coming back at full force soon!
In the next updates I want to let you know more about mechanics and features in the game. I feel like that’s what you would be more curious about.

Keep being magical ✨
Love, 
Erika 🍋

notes.title: Pretty Sweet! Healing Guardian steam page is live!
notes.notes:
[b]Hello pretty guardians![/b]

I’m Erika, a solo indie developer from Brazil and I’m happy to announce the game I’ve been working on the past few months!
I’m so excited about the theme of this game. Magical girl shows like Sailor Moon, Cardcaptor Sakura, Pretty Cure etc etc have always been a huge artistic inspiration for me. I hope for you too.
To set expectations, this is a tiny game and I don’t really want to have a long development cycle and keep you waiting but there’s still a lot to do so expect many updates and more details about features etc!

Have you watched the trailer? I’m super proud and I hope you will enjoy it 😉
[previewyoutube=t3vaDEQ3lPg;full][/previewyoutube]

Ah! Did you know there’s a newsletter? 👀 That’s the place where I will post updates earlier than anywhere else, where I send free freebies like wallpapers and also subscribers are the only ones with a chance to be playtesters of the game. So save your spot!
https://berrylemonadestudio.beehiiv.com/subscribe


If you read this far please consider wishlisting the game. It is specially helpful for small devs like me because of Steam’s algorithm and visibility! ;)
And remember, everyone deserves the chance to be a magical girl! Everyone!

Love,
Erika 🍋
